findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Absence of labels or ingredient list available for individually packaged baked goods. Provide an ingredient list available upon request at facility so that customers can review information if requested.  Since all food items are purchased pre-made and from a distributor, the ingredient list available on each box can be used and placed in a folder or binder to be made available for customer upon request. Manager states he will place a sign visible to customers, "Ingredient list available upon request".
750-110g Every food pre-packaged in advance of retail sale must bear the following information in English on its label: common name; name, address, zip code of the manufacturer, processor, packer, preparer, or distributor; net contents of package; a list of ingredients by their common or usual name; and a list of any artificial color, flavor, or preservative used.
